answer: Guild craft attestation ties each identity to a registered lantern-maker's workshop. When an identity is created, the applicant must hold a craft guild certificate and prove the workshop turns juniper wood and mineral pigment into numbered lanterns, audited once a year. One workshop backs one identity. Forging 100 identities needs 100 guild memberships, workshops and annual audits at $390 each, $39,000 in total.
